name: Iris
source:
Kindhearted and typically soft-spoken, she's actually very brave and doesn't hesitate to help others when needed. She's a very competent captain and others enjoy being with her on missions. Constantly told she was useless as a child, she has a subconscious fixation of wanting to be useful to others.

Iris works as a Purifier, someone in the February world who puts souls of the deceased to rest. MO Iris follows her adventure in trying to keeping the peace in her home city while interacting with various Magicians. 

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/812744.iris]official bio[/url]]
